overview: Jar Jar Binks stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a gungan representative. An awkward Gungan outcast whose clumsy heroism helped unite Naboo against the Trade Federation and who later, tragically, proposed the emergency powers that enabled Palpatine's rise. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, Jar Jar Binks's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
